resources.string: Tap a heart on a game cover to add it here.
Start a game and it will appear here.
No games for this platform yet. Try another category.
Found %1$d games. Choose another folder or continue to the library.
Saved for each platform. Size and position are constrained on smaller screens to keep controls in the safe area.
Unsaved progress will be lost. Return to the library?
The source for “%1$s” is offline. Reconnect the drive or check the game folder in Settings.
Actual speed depends on the game and device performance. With audio enabled, sound plays faster at a higher pitch.
No screenshot yet. A preview will be captured when you save again.
Last automatic save: %1$s. Continue from this save or start the game again.
The previous session could not be restored. Its save may be incompatible or damaged. Return to the library to start again.
Player %1$d controller disconnected. Game paused. Reconnect and choose Resume game.
Choose a virtual button, then press a physical button on this player’s controller. Mappings are saved per player and controller. Directional axes stay unchanged.
Press the physical button to use for %1$s…
Ask to continue when opening a game
Save and return to library updates a separate automatic save without using a manual slot.
The state in this slot will be replaced by your current progress. Other slots are unaffected.
The game will restart and unsaved progress will be lost. Restart now?
The core does not support save states or could not create one. Your game is still open. Retry or confirm leaving without saving.
Provide your own scph5500.bin, scph5501.bin or scph5502.bin (512 KiB) using the button below. Only the filename and size are checked. BIOS downloads are not provided.
BIOS imported. Reopen the PS1 game to use it.
Import failed. Check the BIOS filename, 512 KiB size and available storage.
Applies to this game only. Gives the emulated NES more processing time to reduce slowdown in busy scenes without directly increasing playback speed. Turn off if graphics or audio behave incorrectly.
The ZIP must contain exactly one game supported by this system. Extract it, remove extra games and create a new ZIP.
The game exceeds the 128 MB ZIP extraction limit. Extract it yourself, then add its game folder.
The ZIP is damaged or uses an unsupported compression method. Extract it yourself, then add its game folder.
Internal storage is low. Free some space and retry. External storage cannot replace the internal game cache.
Cannot read the game or its disc files. Connect the USB drive or SD card, check the files still exist, then reselect the game folder in Settings to grant access.
Put memories back in your hands.
Tap or press a controller button to skip
Drag to move. Select a control to resize.
Action failed. Check the save, free storage or rewind history.
Runs every game frame while reducing late presentations. Helps rendering load; original console slowdown remains. FPS diagnostics show average frame time, late frames and cumulative audio underruns.
FC, GB, GBA and SNES only. Keeps up to about 10 seconds or 32 MB. Builds history after enabling, restarting or loading. Uses extra CPU and memory.
Quick save/load uses slot 1. Saving overwrites it and preserves the previous save. Controller: SELECT+R save, SELECT+L load, SELECT+L2 rewind. Keyboard: F5/F8/F6.
